title: Paraparticles intrinsically exhibit Hardy-space breakdown
summary: The memory kernel of an open quantum system obeys Kramers--Kronig (KK) relations if and only if its Laplace transform is analytic in the upper half-plane -- a property known as Hardy-space analyticity. Here we show that non-unitary exchange statistics, the defining property of paraparticles, intrinsically breaks Hardy-space analyticity. The metric $η$ that guarantees a real closed-system spectrum for these particles necessarily differs from the physical Born inner product ($\|η- I\|_F / \|I\|_F = 0.51$) -- a mathematical consequence of the R-matrix's non-unitarity, not a parameter choice.…
